memories.content: Nine households on Alder Court have discussed setting up a water table for the marathon and said they are in. They have a neighborhood app for communication. No one has yet set up the table. They may or may not coordinate effectively.

The Riverton marathon starts Sunday at 07:00. The first runners pass the Alder Court corner (mile four) around 08:30. The city's runner guide lists their corner as mile four. The weather forecast is fine. The neighbors have discussed the water table all month on the app. Nine households said they are in. Priya has bought cups. The table has not been set up yet as of the simulation start time.
